# End Violence Against Women Now (endvawnow.org)

> A comprehensive UN Women-backed Virtual Knowledge Centre providing evidence-based guidance, tools, and frameworks for preventing violence against women and girls across multiple sectors and contexts.

endvawnow.org is a global resource hub developed in partnership with UN Women and the Spotlight Initiative, offering sector-specific programming guidance, policy frameworks, and coordinated response strategies for governments, NGOs, and humanitarian organizations working to end VAWG. The platform integrates international human rights law, humanitarian standards, and proven prevention approaches across education, health, justice, security, and community-based interventions.

## Key Topics

- Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG)
- Gender-Based Violence (GBV)
- Violence Prevention Programming
- Human Rights Approach
- UN Women
- Spotlight Initiative
- Survivor-Centered Care
- Safe Cities Framework
- Multi-Sector Coordination
- Policy Guidance and Legislation
- Women Empowerment
- International Humanitarian Law
- Gender Equality
- Prevention Programs
- Knowledge Resources

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://endvawnow.org/en): Main entry point for the Virtual Knowledge Centre to End Violence against Women and Girls
- [About](https://endvawnow.org/en/about): Mission, vision, and UN Women partnership information for the Virtual Knowledge Centre
- [Tools Directory](https://endvawnow.org/en/tools): Searchable collection of resources and tools for violence prevention programming

## Sector-Specific Guidance

- [Education](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/5-education.html): Education sector guidance on school safety and SGBV prevention programming
- [Health](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/6-health.html): Health sector response guidance for survivor-centered care and VAWG prevention
- [Justice](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/7-justice.html): Justice sector guidance on formal and informal mechanisms for VAWG accountability
- [Security](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/13-security.html): Security sector engagement guidance for police and military VAWG prevention training

## Policy and Legal Frameworks

- [Legislation](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/8-legislation.html): Policy guidance and drafting guide for VAWG legislation and human rights frameworks
- [Campaigns](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/3-campaigns.html): Guide for planning and implementing advocacy campaigns against violence toward women
- [Coordinated Responses](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/16-coordinated-responses.html): Framework for coordinated multi-sector responses to violence against women and girls

## Prevention and Programming

- [Men & Boys Engagement](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/9-men-boys.html): Programming guidance for engaging men and boys in violence prevention efforts
- [Safe Cities](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/12-safe-cities.html): Safe Cities framework addressing gender-based violence in public urban spaces
- [Shelter Services](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/15-shelter.html): Shelter services guidance for safe accommodation and survivor support programming
- [Programming Essentials, Monitoring & Evaluation](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/14-programming-essentials-monitoring-evaluation.html): Guide on programming essentials, monitoring and evaluation for VAWG prevention

## Humanitarian and Conflict Settings

- [Conflict/Post-Conflict](https://endvawnow.org/en/modules/view/4-conflict-post-conflict.html): Documentation on addressing VAWG in conflict and post-conflict humanitarian settings

## Support and Resources

- [Need Help?](https://endvawnow.org/en/need-help): Crisis helplines and emergency resources for domestic violence victims and survivors

## Optional

- [Events Calendar](https://endvawnow.org/en/events): Upcoming VAWG-related events and activities
